name: Roti Paratha with Curry Dip
description: Flaky, multi-layered buttery Indonesian flatbread served with hot aromatic chicken coconut curry dip.

name: Martabak Telor
description: Crispy pan-fried stuffed flatbread with spiced ground beef, scrambled eggs, green scallions, side sweet chili dip.

name: Chicken Sate (4 Skewers)
description: Char-grilled marinated chicken skewers glazed in sweet kecap manis and served with thick spiced peanut sauce.

name: Mie Tek Tek Street Noodles
description: Wok-fried egg noodles with tender chicken breast, eggs, shredded cabbage, bok choy, and savory street sauce.

name: Kwetiau Goreng (Flat Rice Noodles)
description: Wok-charred wide flat rice noodles with bean sprouts, Chinese greens, fried eggs, and sweet soy reduction.

name: Nasi Goreng Fried Rice
description: Fragrant Indonesian wok fried rice with chicken, scallions, fried shallots, sunny-side egg, and krupuk shrimp chips.

name: Nasi Bungkus Rendang (Banana Leaf Wrap)
description: Slow-braised Sumatran beef rendang in toasted coconut spices, vegetable curry, sambal egg, wrapped in banana leaf.

name: Hainanese Poached Chicken
description: Aromatic chicken poached in ginger and broth, served over jasmine chicken rice with garlic ginger and chili sambal.

name: Teh Botol Sosro
description: Legendary Indonesian sweet jasmine iced tea in glass bottle.

name: Es Cendol
description: Iced dessert beverage with green pandan jelly ribbons, coconut milk, and shaved palm sugar syrup.
